text.aria-label: Title text 'Removing the hour and day-of-year columns helped the ENS-trained model a lot and the ERA5-trained model little'

g.text: Removing the hour and day-of-year columns helped the ENS-trained model a lot and the ERA5-trained model little

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in mean absolute error when the hour and day-of-year columns are removed, points of capacity (more negative is better), and when the 24 production columns are replaced by the same columns as the ERA5-trained model. Solid line at zero: no change. Blue: ERA5-trained model, hour and day-of-year columns removed. Orange: ENS-trained model, same removal. Purple: ENS-trained model on the common columns against the production ENS-trained model with 24 columns, including power lags. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. All three comparisons are post hoc. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.'
text.tspan: Change in mean absolute error when the hour and day-of-year columns are removed, points of capacity (more negative is better), and when the 24 production columns are replaced by the same columns as the ERA5-trained model. Solid line at zero: no change.

Blue: ERA5-trained model, hour and day-of-year columns removed. Orange: ENS-trained model, same removal. Purple: ENS-trained model on the common columns against the production ENS-trained model with 24 columns, including power lags. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. All three comparisons are post hoc.

ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
